summary: 24 Werktage statutory minimum (= 20 days on a 5-day week); 6-month waiting period; certified sickness during leave is not counted; carry-over lapses 31 March only if the employer warned the employee.

owner.role: Employment counsel (DE) + HR Business Partner DE

locationAssumption.citation: Groupon GmbH employees assumed to work in Berlin (Land determines public holidays)
locationAssumption.note: Confirm work location per employee; Bavaria/NRW would change holidays.

rule.citation: BUrlG §3(2): Werktage exclude Sundays and statutory public holidays — holidays inside leave are not deducted

source.citation: Berliner Gesetz über die Sonn- und Feiertage (Feiertagsgesetz) incl. Frauentag since 2019
source.note: Easter-derived dates cross-checked by computus in tests.

rule.citation: No statutory substitute day when a holiday falls on a weekend
BUrlG §3(1): at least 24 Werktage per year; converted to the employee's pattern as 24 × days-per-week ÷ 6
BUrlG §4 (full entitlement after 6-month waiting period) and §5 (1/12 per full month in partial years; fractions ≥ ½ day round up)
BUrlG §7(3): carry-over to 31 March; lapse only if the employer informed and invited the employee to take leave (CJEU C-684/16 Max-Planck, BAG 9 AZR 423/16)
rule.note: Assumes Groupon GmbH carries over automatically; statute requires urgent operational/personal reasons.

rule.citation: BUrlG §9: days of incapacity proven by medical certificate are not counted as leave
BUrlG §7(4): compensation only if leave cannot be taken because employment ends

extras.label: Severe disability supplement
extras.citation: SGB IX §208: +5 working days (5-day week) for severely disabled employees

extras.label: 24 & 31 December
extras.citation: 24 and 31 December are not statutory holidays in Berlin; treated as ordinary working days
extras.note: Many German employers grant half days by policy or collective agreement — verify Groupon GmbH policy.

extras.label: Collective agreements
extras.citation: Contracts / works agreements may grant more than the statutory minimum (e.g. 25–30 days)
extras.note: Contractual surplus days can have different carry-over rules; not modelled until agreements are seen.
